user.title: Set up Manometer-Leser
user.description: Select the camera of the ESP32-CAM (ESPHome) and, if available, its light (flash LED). Then calibrate in the sidebar under “Manometer”.

error.camera_missing: Please select an existing camera entity.

add_note.name: Add note
add_note.description: Adds a note to the pressure history, e.g. that water was refilled. Without a time, a measurement follows right away.
